972class Device: 

973 """Represent a GPU and act as an entry point for cuda.core features. 

974  

975 This is a singleton object that helps ensure interoperability 

976 across multiple libraries imported in the process to both see 

977 and use the same GPU device. 

978  

979 While acting as the entry point, many other CUDA resources can be 

980 allocated such as streams and buffers. Any :obj:`~_context.Context` dependent 

981 resource created through this device, will continue to refer to 

982 this device's context. 

983  

984 Newly returned :obj:`~_device.Device` objects are thread-local singletons 

985 for a specified device. 

986  

987 Note 

988 ---- 

989 Will not initialize the GPU. 

990  

991 Parameters 

992 ---------- 

993 device_id : int, optional 

994 Device ordinal to return a :obj:`~_device.Device` object for. 

995 Default value of `None` return the currently used device. 

996  

997 """

1002 "_properties", 

1003 "_resources", 

1004 "_uuid", 

1005 "_context", 

1006 "__weakref__", 

1007 )

1081 def can_access_peer(self, peer: Device | int) -> bool: 

1082 """Check if this device can access memory from the specified peer device. 

1083  

1084 Queries whether peer-to-peer memory access is supported between this 

1085 device and the specified peer device. 

1086  

1087 Parameters 

1088 ---------- 

1089 peer : Device | int 

1090 The peer device to check accessibility to. Can be a :obj:`~_device.Device` object or device ID. 

1091 """ 

1092 peer = Device(peer) 

1093 cdef int d1 = <int> self.device_id 

1094 cdef int d2 = <int> peer.device_id 

1095 if d1 == d2: 

1096 return True 

1097 cdef int value = 0 

1098 with nogil: 

1099 HANDLE_RETURN(cydriver.cuDeviceCanAccessPeer(&value, d1, d2)) 

1100 return bool(value)

1257 def set_current(self, ctx: Context | None = None) -> Context | None: 

1258 """Set device to be used for GPU executions. 

1259  

1260 Initializes CUDA and sets the calling thread to a valid CUDA 

1261 context. By default the primary context is used, but optional `ctx` 

1262 parameter can be used to explicitly supply a :obj:`~_context.Context` object. 

1263  

1264 Providing a `ctx` causes the previous set context to be popped and returned. 

1265  

1266 If `ctx` was created on a different device than this receiver, the call 

1267 is delegated to that device's own :meth:`set_current`. This keeps the 

1268 owning device's bookkeeping consistent and lets a context this method 

1269 handed out for a foreign device be pushed back through any ``Device`` 

1270 object, matching the CUDA context stack's own thread-wide semantics. 

1271  

1272 Parameters 

1273 ---------- 

1274 ctx : :obj:`~_context.Context`, optional 

1275 Optional context to push onto this device's current thread stack. 

1276  

1277 Returns 

1278 ------- 

1279 :obj:`~_context.Context`, optional 

1280 The previous context, or ``None`` if no context was current. When 

1281 returned, its ``device_id`` identifies the device that was 

1282 previously current. 

1283  

1284 Examples 

1285 -------- 

1286 Acts as an entry point of this object. Users always start a code by 

1287 calling this method, e.g. 

1288  

1289 >>> from cuda.core import Device 

1290 >>> dev0 = Device(0) 

1291 >>> dev0.set_current() 

1292 >>> # ... do work on device 0 ... 

1293
